description: This file implements the WarningReportingUnit class, which manages warning reporting categories, their configurations, and event reporting within the WPEFramework. It includes methods for singleton access, category management, configuration defaults, and warning event reporting.

classes.name: WarningReportingUnit
classes.description: Singleton class managing warning categories, their configurations, and reporting within the WPEFramework.

methods.name: WarningReportingUnit()
methods.description: Constructor initializing categories and lock, and registering the instance with the proxy.

methods.name: Instance()
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of WarningReportingUnit.

methods.name: ~WarningReportingUnit()
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up categories and unregistering the instance.

methods.name: GetCategories()
methods.description: Returns a list of category names currently managed.

methods.name: AddToCategoryList()
methods.description: Adds a category control to the internal list.

methods.name: RemoveFromCategoryList()
methods.description: Removes a category control from the internal list.

methods.name: Defaults()
methods.description: Returns the current default categories as a JSON string.

methods.name: Defaults(const string& jsonCategories)
methods.description: Sets default categories from a JSON string, parsing and updating internal state.

methods.name: UpdateEnabledCategories()
methods.description: Updates the enabled/disabled state and configuration of categories based on provided JSON data.

methods.name: FetchCategoryInformation()
methods.description: Retrieves information about a specific category, including whether it is default, enabled, and its configuration.

methods.name: ReportWarningEvent()
methods.description: Reports a warning event with associated metadata and message content.
